text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Watchdog national commission in charge of elections follow-up focuses on constituencies division.
- Conseil National pour la Jeunesse et L'Avenir (CNJA) becomes member of the United Nations Social and Economic Council.
- Morocco to host national seminar on children's rights on May 25. AL-BAYANE
- United Arab Emirates Foreign Minister Rashid Abdullal al-Nuaimi arrived in Morocco, bearing a message from Sheikh Zaid to King Hassan.
- Interior ministry says Morocco will tighten anti-drugs penalties.
- Morocco and China to cooperate on phosphates industry business.
- State-owned agriculture fund Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole to improve its finance management.
